editor.fontFamily.label: Font family
editor.fontFamily.description: Installed fonts, in fallback order. Owlet does not download fonts.

editor.lineHeight.label: Line height
editor.lineHeight.description: Line spacing as a multiple of font size.

editor.wordWrap.label: Word wrap
editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long source lines to the editor width.

editor.vimMode.label: Vim mode
editor.vimMode.description: Use Vim keybindings in source and settings JSON editors.

preview.fontSize.label: Font size
preview.fontSize.description: Reading text size in pixels. Headings and code scale with it.

preview.lineHeight.label: Line height
preview.lineHeight.description: Reading line spacing as a multiple of font size.

preview.maxWidth.label: Maximum width
preview.maxWidth.description: Maximum Markdown content width in pixels at 100% preview zoom. Use 0 to fill the pane.

markdown.defaultView.label: Default view
markdown.defaultView.description: View used when opening a Markdown file. Existing tabs keep their view.

terminal.fontSize.label: Font size
terminal.fontSize.description: Terminal text size in pixels. Applies without restarting shells.

terminal.fontFamily.label: Font family
terminal.fontFamily.description: Use an installed monospace font for terminal alignment.

terminal.lineHeight.label: Line height
terminal.lineHeight.description: Terminal line spacing as a multiple of font size.

terminal.scrollback.label: Scrollback
terminal.scrollback.description: Retained terminal lines. Reducing this discards older scrollback.

search.maxResults.label: Maximum result lines
search.maxResults.description: Stop with partial results at this many matching lines.

search.timeoutSeconds.label: Time limit
search.timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds per search. Limited searches retain their results.

search.maxResultMB.label: Result size limit
search.maxResultMB.description: Maximum MiB of result snippets per search.

search.maxFileSizeMB.label: Maximum file size
search.maxFileSizeMB.description: Skip larger files (MiB). The source editor supports files up to 4 MiB.

search.maxDepth.label: Maximum depth
search.maxDepth.description: 0 searches all depths. Independent of the Ctrl+P filename index.

search.exclude.label: Excluded paths
search.exclude.description: Comma-separated globs, relative to the search folder. Empty searches all non-ignored paths. Git metadata is always excluded.

files.quickOpenMaxDepth.label: Quick Open maximum depth
files.quickOpenMaxDepth.description: Subdirectory levels to index for Ctrl+P. 0 searches the workspace root only. Indexing runs in the background.
